summary: {member} asks staff to bring back separate prices for two city courses before voting.
realLife: Council asked Portland parks staff to minimize increases at Colwood while concentrating adult-round revenue at four named courses.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: two named courses and the rates proposed for each.

turns.pulledBy: One course is singled out for a smaller increase.
turns.what: The member asks what the other courses must collect.
turns.writesBack: The proposal carries a course-by-course estimate.

turns.pulledBy: A reduction applies only at the named course.
turns.what: Staff tell players where the lower rate is available.
turns.writesBack: The posted schedule identifies the eligible site.
